description: The O1→O2→O5 knowledge pipeline. O1 is an accepted signed/sanitized inbox note, O2 is an append to the dated daily log, and O5 is a staged candidate that only an explicit human confirmation promotes into 05_Knowledge/. The pipeline never deletes the source, widens scope or lowers classification.

eligibility.rule: An unsigned/pending item is skipped, never silently treated as accepted.

o2.companion: If the date page exists without a tracking block, write 02_Daily/YYYY-MM-DD-o2.md instead of modifying a human page.
o2.content: A dated section containing the source path, digest, classification and source body.
o2.signing: The O2 note is signed with the user key; an existing tracked page is re-signed after the append.
o2.idempotency: The source digest marker is the idempotency key; a second apply does not duplicate the section.

o5.promotion: Only an explicit `promote --category ... --confirm` moves the candidate to 05_Knowledge/<category>/<slug>.md.
o5.collision: A target that already exists is refused; a staging path with a different source digest is a conflict and blocks apply.

inheritance.classification: The O2 and O5 records inherit the O1 classification; a lower classification is refused.
inheritance.department: The department is inherited when present.
inheritance.provenance: source_path, source_sha256 and captured date travel with both derived records.

rules: The O1 source is never deleted or moved by the pipeline.
O5 promotion is a human action, never automatic.
A conflict is held for a human; it is never overwritten.
A derived note is signed or refused, not written unsigned.
The pipeline is not authority: it cannot grant, revoke or widen a capability.
